Method of Attack: Exploiting vulnerabilities CVE-2018-10561 and CVE-2018-10562 to take over Dasan GPON routers
Impacted Systems: Dasan GPON-capable routers, specifically ZNID-GPON-25xx series and certain H640 series GPON ONTs
Attack Vector: Exploitation of router vulnerabilities CVE-2018-10561 and CVE-2018-10562
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of botnet command and control servers
Shodan search results indicating exposed devices
